messages:
maria-pm: Quick announcement — we're planning to deprecate the SDK CLI v1 plugin API (the external plugin hooks used by third-party extensions) in 90 days (EOM + 3 months). This is driven by the v2 CLI's new plugin contract which improves startup time, security boundaries, and telemetry consistency. We will publish a migration guide and a compatibility shim that covers the most common plugin surface. Please read the plan below and flag blockers.

alex-eng: Is the compatibility shim going to be source-compatible, or will plugin authors need to recompile/bundle? Any perf tradeoffs?

maria-pm: The shim will be source-compatible for JS/TS plugins and will run as a lightweight bridge process. Perf impact should be <5% in warm cases; cold start might be higher. We'll document benchmarks.

sam-docs: I'll own docs updates. Plan: land a migration doc + examples in the next 2 weeks, add a prominent banner on the v1 pages, and add redirect notes to the new API. Need sample code from eng for the shim.

alex-eng: I'll drop a minimal shim example here in a bit. Also proposing a feature flag so Dedicated/private customers can opt-in to hold v1 behavior for 6 more months while they test.

ben-ops: For Dedicated customers, we need a rollout matrix: opt-in window, opt-out, and a plan for emergency rollback if we see plugin breakage. Also cc'ing eng-security to confirm KMS/HSM boundaries aren't affected.

devex-bot: Checklist created: https://rbw.internal/doc/checklists/cli-v1-deprecation. Items: migration guide, shim repo, sample plugins, docs banner, support playbook, compat telemetry.

sam-docs: We'll also add a 'what to expect' changelog entry and an automated migration script for common patterns.

alex-eng: shim snippet:
```
// shim/index.js
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
// bridge that translates v1 hooks -> v2 contract
spawn('node', ['plugin-bridge.js', ...process.argv.slice(2)], { stdio: 'inherit' });
```

maria-pm: Timeline: publish proposal + shim repo by 2026-05-04, docs and migration guide by 2026-05-18, start gradual enforcement (warnings -> opt-in-only) on 2026-06-01, deprecate enforcement on 2026-09-01. Support SLA: 90 days of full support after enforcement. If you have customers that rely on v1, DM me the list.

ben-ops: Thanks. Can we add a signal in logs for plugin compatibility regressions? We'll surface in Console.

alex-eng: Yes — we'll emit metric `cli.plugin_compat.failure_count` and a per-plugin tag.

sam-docs: noted. I'll coordinate releases to include migration checklist, code samples, and FAQ.

maria-pm: Thanks team. If nothing else, rolling with this plan. :party_parrot:

sam-docs: :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync in #devex on 2026-05-06 10:00am PT.
